brief.objective: Produce the minimum safe implementation. Reuse existing code whenever possible.

instruction:
MISSION: EXECUTION_STATUS

OBJECTIVE:
Report the current autonomous execution state.

REQUIREMENTS:
- Do not modify any file.
- Do not implement any change.
- Report the current mission, if any.
- Report the last completed mission.
- Report the next planned mission.
- State whether autonomous execution is currently active.
- If execution is stopped, explain exactly why.
- If execution is active, report the current progress against the roadmap.
- Produce only a status report.
